summaries.text: This resolution recognizes April 14, 2025, as World Quantum Day and encourages schools and educators to observe the day with activities that teach students about quantum physics.

title: A resolution recognizing April 14, 2025, as "World Quantum Day", and commemorating and supporting the goals of World Quantum Day.
